labeled_ranges.label: This unhandled promise-like value has type `Promise<never>`.
This rejection handler has type `undefined`, which is not callable.

message.description: Promises must be awaited, add void operator to ignore.
message.help: The promise must end with a call to .catch, or end with a call to .then with a rejection handler, or be explicitly marked as ignored with the `void` operator. A rejection handler that is not a function will be ignored.
